Step 5 of 6

Save and leave
AI is optional

You can read and organise files without AI. Connect a service only when you want to ask a question.

What works without paying for AI
Read the sample, import Markdown or text, organise your library, and view connected school coursework.
An API key is a secret code for an AI account
OpenAI or Anthropic can charge for questions sent with a key. A ChatGPT or Claude chat subscription does not automatically include API use.
Already use Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity?
Their command-line apps use a separate sign-in in Terminal. Enable one in Settings after signing in. Its plan limits and fees still apply. Nothing is enabled here.
Before anything leaves this Mac
An enabled provider receives your question, chat history, document details, and selected text. Without a selection, it receives an outline and opening excerpt. Earlier selections can remain in history. Enabled command-line apps may also contact their own services. VStudy sends no analytics.
Before saving a key
Saving or unlocking a key may ask for macOS Keychain access. Settings also offers “Use without saving keys” for this session only. Skip setup to avoid these prompts.
